tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to bud, sprout, shoot, bloom

1b) (Hiphil)

1b2) to show buds or sprouts

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] abroad, [idiom] abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).
